title: Hot Crispy Spanish Chicken Croquettes
description: A festive Spanish dish featuring crispy fried chicken and jammy brown sugar flavors, perfect for a low-carb friendly snack or appetizer. This double-fry method ensures a crunchy exterior and juicy interior.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together diced chicken, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix together almond flour and a pinch of salt.
Dip each chicken piece into the beaten eggs and then coat in the almond flour mixture.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350 degrees.
Fry the chicken pieces in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried chicken from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Increase the oil temperature to 375 degrees and fry the chicken pieces again in batches until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the croquettes from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the hot crispy Spanish chicken croquettes immediately and enjoy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
